cues: The formation equation uses half a mole of chlorine gas, so only half the bond enthalpy, one twenty one, goes into the cycle.
Use the whole two forty two, and your answer is off by one hundred and twenty one kilojoules.
text: The commonest Born Haber error. The formation equation uses half a mole of chlorine gas, so only half the bond enthalpy, one twenty one, goes into the cycle. Use the whole two forty two, and your answer is off by one hundred and twenty one kilojoules.
